source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of electric potential (PDF 62-65).

blocks.text: Kisi nuqte ke potential ko qeemat dene ke liye hamein aik hawala nuqta chahiye jise sifar potential diya jaye; yeh aam taur par infinity par liya jata hai. Agar A infinity par ho aur VA = 0, to B par potential VB = W/qo, ya sirf V = W/qo (16.6).

blocks.title: Electric potential
blocks.text: Electric field mein kisi nuqte par electric potential woh kaam hai jo aik ikai musbat charge ko infinity se us nuqte tak, electrostatic tawazun mein rakhte hue, lane mein kiya jaye. Potential aur potential difference dono scalar miqdarein hain, kyunke kaam aur charge scalars hain.

Point charge q ka field radial hai (Fig 16.2) aur 1/r^2 ki tarah badalta hai, is liye lambe faasle par dV = -E dr seedha istemal nahi ho sakta. Do nuqte A aur B bohat qareeb lein, q se rA aur rB faasle par, taake un ke darmiyan E taqreeban constant rahe: rB = rA + dr (16.7). Un ke darmiyani nuqte r par field E = (1/4 pi eo) q / r^2 (16.10) hai; kyunke nuqte bohat qareeb hain, rA aur rB ka arithmetic mean geometric mean ke barabar liya ja sakta hai, is liye r^2 = rA rB (16.11) aur E = (1/4 pi eo) q / (rA rB) (16.12).

blocks.alt: Musbat point charge q jis se solah seedhi field lines bahar ki taraf nikalti hain, har aik par teer. Daen field line par nuqte A aur B; dashed teer q se un ke faasle rA aur rB, aur A aur B ka darmiyani faasla delta r dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.2: Point charge q ka radial field, nuqte A aur B ke saath (kitab ki Figure 16.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Aik ikai musbat charge ko B se A tak le jane ka kaam potential difference ke barabar hai: VA - VB = E (rB - rA) (16.13). E rakhne se VA - VB = (1/4 pi eo) q (rB - rA)/(rA rB) = (1/4 pi eo) q (1/rA - 1/rB) (16.15). Yeh kisi bhi do nuqton ke liye durust hai, kyunke lamba rasta bohat se chhote qadmon se banta hai jin ke hisse jore jore khatam ho jate hain. B ko infinity par lene se (VB = 0, 1/rB = 0) VA = (1/4 pi eo) q / rA (16.16), aur aam taur par q se r faasle par potential V = (1/4 pi eo) q / r (16.17).
Agar q manfi ho to potential manfi hai. Kai charges hon to har aik potential mein hissa dalta hai, aur kisi nuqte par kul potential alag alag potentials ka algebraic jor hai.
5.0 x 10^-8 C charge se 1.2 m door nuqte par potential maloom karein. Hal: V = (1/4 pi eo) q / r = (9 x 10^9 N m^2 C^-2)(5.0 x 10^-8 C) / 1.2 m = 375 V.

+8 uC aur -4 uC charges 60 cm door hain (Fig 16.3). Un se guzarti lakeer par potential kahan sifar hai? Hal: potential wahan sifar hai jahan musbat aur manfi hisse barabar hon. Kyunke musbat charge bara hai, dono sifar nuqte chhote manfi charge ke qareeb hain: aik charges ke darmiyan (A) aur aik manfi charge se aage (B). A par, musbat charge se x faasle par: k(8 uC)/x = k(4 uC)/(60 cm - x), is liye 8(60 - x) = 4x, 480 - 8x = 4x, aur x = 40 cm. B par, manfi charge se y aage: k(8 uC)/(60 cm + y) = k(4 uC)/y, is liye 8y = 4(60 + y), 4y = 240 cm, aur y = 60 cm.

blocks.title: Nuqta B ka hal
blocks.text: Kitab mein B ke potentials ke liye likhe formulas A wale dohrate hain (x aur 60 cm - x ke saath); istemal shuda tawazun ki shart, 4(60 cm + y) = 8y, B ke liye durust hai, jaisa oopar dikhaya gaya.

blocks.alt: Aik lakeer par +8 microcoulomb aur -4 microcoulomb charges 60 cm door. Nuqta A dono ke darmiyan, +8 se x aur -4 se (60 cm - x) faasle par. Nuqta B -4 microcoulomb ke paar, us se y aur +8 se (60 cm + y) faasle par.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.3: 60 cm door +8 microcoulomb aur -4 microcoulomb charges, nuqte A aur B ke saath (kitab ki Figure 16.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Misal 16.3 mein kya +8 uC charge ke baen taraf kaheen potential sifar hai? Wajah dein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Baen taraf har nuqta -4 uC ke muqable bare +8 uC ke zyada qareeb hai, is liye musbat hissa hamesha zyada aur V kabhi sifar nahi (siwaye bohat door, jahan yeh sifar ki taraf jata hai).

items: Infinity par sifar ke saath V = W/qo; potential scalar.
Point charge: V = (1/4 pi eo) q / r; manfi q ke liye manfi.
